title: THE WEIRWOOD PARADOX // PUSHING ONESELF OUT THE WINDOW
narrative: Bran plugs his third eye into the weirwood mainframe. He travels back to the First Keep on the day Robert visited Winterfell. Seeing Jaime and Cersei in the broken tower, Bran realizes that if he is never pushed, he will never journey north, never become the Three-Eyed Raven, and never save humanity. He wargs into Jaime Lannister's golden hand, grabs ten-year-old Bran by the collar, mutters 'The things I do for love,' and shoves himself out the ledge. 'Bootstrap paradox completed,' Bran's raven eye twitches.
